title: Six nations, Italy beats Wales 22-15 at the Olimpico
text:
ROMA – For the first time in 26 editions of the tournament and after 126 games, the Italia was favored on the eve of a meeting of Six nations . The blues were able to keep faith with the prediction with a solid and judicious 70 minutes of match but a thrilling ending, overcoming in the swinging rain (22-15) a Galls in deep crisis and already intended for a second Wooden spoon consecutive. Aggressive in defense, attentive to the kicks high opponents and shiny on the rare attack opportunities, the Italians closed the first half in clear advantage thanks to a destination of Capuozzo and the kicks of Allan . In the second half they managed for a long time but they were surprisingly lost in the final in front of the organic return of the guests. Two less players and the others in full competitive trance: the Olympic However, he exploded with joy when Zuliani He recovered the decisive oval that celebrates a home success on dragons expected for 18 years. The platelets of Nicotera, Lamaro e Niccolò Cannone the imperious force of FISCHETTI, Ferrari e Negri . And the five free kicks of Allan. “It will be because I love you,” sings the stadium: these guys deserved the success and embrace of the public, in two weeks new Roman appointment with the very strong France .
Capuozzo, the destination of the blue ANGE After a great fright after two minutes just (one meter from the destination, the oval slips through the hands of Adams, who had collected an external cross of Tomos Williams), the blues took the lead thanks to a punishment of Allan. The rain multiplied the management errors, Wales remedied with a football by Ben Thomas. The balance broke in the middle of the first half with a perfect action in the first phase: Page-Realo started from a fray ordered on the 22 opponents, Paolo Garbisi with a soccer to follow served Capuozzo who crushed the ball in the plastic dip A few centimeters from the side line. Allan’s transformation was another little jewel. Around half an hour, the extreme has gained the score on punishment 2 times. In the final of the first half, another forward wretched by Adams frustrated the residual hopes of the dragons.
Allan kicks, but what suffering in the second half In the second half, two errors on the punishment of Allan and a crossbar-always from the Piazzola-of Page-Realo preceded a bad foul by Adams on Paolo Garbisi, with the opening forced to go out for a medical supervision by Concussion and the Welsh wing Out for 10 minutes. The umpteenth foul by Dragoni has finally allowed the extreme blue to capitalize with another 3 points, but in numerical inferiority, Wales managed to go to the destination with Wainwright after a penalty, taking advantage of a guilty moment of indecision of the Italians. The balances are suddenly skipped, Wales pushed our forwards with courage and closed in one corner: the expulsions of Riccioni and Lamb, the destination of punishment. What a fear. In 13 against 15, Zuliani imprisoned the oval at the end, earning the punishment that triggered the joy.
